blocks.text: St. Finnian’s monastery was at Movilla near Newtownards in County Down. The name Moville in many English church sources refers to that foundation, rather than the modern town of Moville in Donegal. The historical reference records differing traditions about his family and possible British background.

blocks.text: He was remembered for scriptural scholarship and the formation of monks. Early accounts associate him with the education of St. Columba of Iona; the OCA also names him as St. Comgall’s teacher. The historical reference distinguishes these early testimonies from a much later story about a copied Psalter and a battle.
